api: Unchanged continuous_research_shared_v1: 24 attempts/day including retries, 6500 input and 1500 output/request, USD0.25/day and USD5/month. All old reservations persist. API WAIT does not block local candidates or space creation.
primitive_parameters: J/L/M/N exact previously supported phase2_development_contract gene_space; K previously frozen refined envelope. No new feature lookbacks or data sources.
composition: BLEND of exactly two distinct primitive families, canonical ascending family order. Weight reversal normalized for dedup. Signals at prior close; each component keeps independent prior signal memory. Weighted sum of component target vectors executes in ONE original costed quantity/cash book at next open. No averaging returns/equity. No nested blends; N remains standalone because its intraday stops cannot be represented by a target-only blend.
meta_policy: On exhaustion of current frozen space with no open batch, ready proposal or unresolved scientific attempt, rotate supported categories. Rank eligible completed train/validation evidence; project supported shared parameter values into other families. Freeze a bounded neighborhood grid around the best eligible seed or first globally unseen canonical enumeration seed. Primitive grids at most 3 values/axis; blend grids vary one axis/component plus three weights. All existing global genes and rule+gene hashes suppress repeats. Deterministic plans have LOCAL_META_POLICY provenance, not AI authorship.
scan_policy: Append-only per-category ordinal cursor; bounded scans checkpoint skipped configurations and continue automatically. Cursor exhaustion for every finite supported category gives honest IDLE_META_GRAMMAR_EXHAUSTED. WAIT_META_SCAN is not progress in evaluated candidates. No claim of infinite new supported mechanisms.
pending_AI: Old queued requests retain exact wire and billing identity. Late proposals from ended spaces are recorded/rejected against current frozen scope; waiting for paid quota must not hold local research hostage. New requests contain compact permitted schemas and at most two eligible parent summaries.
freeze: Existing immutable spaces preserved. New meta spaces append parent space hash, exact grammar, evidence digest/count and parent summaries, mapping semantics, windows, frequency policy, contamination, accumulated alpha and conditional resolution/power before admission. Every batch binds a space before evaluation. Resource interruptions reuse scientific reservation and backtest key.
science: No change to development cutoff 2026-09-25, feedback cutoff 2021-12-17, original train/validation windows, locked interval 2026-09-27..2027-09-26, lifetime alpha 0.05/[t*(t+1)] inherited 1444, or 30-day blocks/14-day gaps/minimum30. All observed history and repeated selection remain contaminated development; no conditional p-value confirms a trading candidate. Full selection evidence retained forever; invalid/missing prices or LUNA exits are never fabricated and only invalidate affected candidates.
status: Separate resource admission, actual completed candidates/backtests, local/AI origins and provider reservations. Timer enabled, frontier scans and space freezes are not actual backtest progress.
